principles: Membership records permission and contamination ancestry; it does not upgrade any historical result or make any member fresh E2 evidence.

A repository is excluded from the primary fresh E2 block if its target bytes, target-derived fixtures, or target-specific expected outcomes are available for E2 implementation, debugging, or qualification.
When historical provenance is coarser than an exact target-byte revision, exclusion is conservative rather than under-declared.
Unit005 is exclusion-only contaminated forensics: its recorded exposure disqualifies the repository from fresh use, but its semantics may not serve as an E2 benchmark.
New real-target-derived inputs may be added only through an append-only numbered universe amendment committed before the new target bytes or target-specific expected outcome are consumed.
The final E2 engine freeze must bind the complete effective universe and its derived repository exclusion set.
Registration in the fresh-repository exclusion set is not permission to fetch or use arbitrary external target bytes; byte-access permission is explicitly recorded per member.
purpose: Make every real-target-derived input and target-specific expected outcome available to E2 development explicit before use, and derive a conservative repository exclusion set for the future primary fresh held-out block.

source_library_and_provider_evidence_rul.reason: The firewall excludes target-side specialization without unnecessarily banning authoritative semantic specifications from future source-lane construction.
source_library_and_provider_evidence_rul.rule: Authoritative source/provider repositories consulted only to understand public source semantics are not automatically excluded unless their implementation bytes become E2 target-side development/qualification inputs.
